paite: Ka it luat thu, agrephuan tungtang thu, ka it luat a ding in la in ka sata mai ding. Ka it luat in lei hoihna mahmah mual ah grephuan anei hi.
heading: Grephuan La
english: Let me sing for my well beloved a song of my beloved about his vineyard. My beloved had a vineyard on a very fruitful hill.

paite: Akimvel in lei atoukuak a, asuangte atomsiang a, grepgui hoihpen asuan a, alai ah insang alam a, huai ah grep sukna khuk leng atou hi. Huchi in grep gah a gah ding in alamen a, himahleh grep tak lou ahong gah maimah hi.
english: He dug it up, gathered out its stones, planted it with the choicest vine, built a tower in the middle of it, and also cut out a wine press in it. He looked for it to yield grapes, but it yielded wild grapes.

paite: Tu in, Jerusalem a omte leh Judah mite aw, "Hehpih in kei leh ka grephuan kal thu hon ngaihtuah dih ve ua.
english: “Now, inhabitants of Jerusalem and men of Judah, please judge between me and my vineyard.

paite: Tua grephuan ah ka hihsa akan-aval atung ah hih nawn lailai ding bangbang om ahita mai a? Bangziak in ahia, grep gah a gah ding a ka lamet et toh, grep tak lou ahong gah maimah?
english: What could have been done more to my vineyard, that I have not done in it? Why, when I looked for it to yield grapes, did it yield wild grapes?

paite: "Tu in ngai un, ka grephuan tung ah ka hih ding ka hon hilh ding; aling dai ka lamang ding a, nekgaih in a-om ding; asuangdai ka chimsak ding a, sikden in a-om ding.
english: Now I will tell you what I will do to my vineyard. I will take away its hedge, and it will be eaten up. I will break down its wall, and it will be trampled down.

paite: Huan ka hihse vek ding a; satnou in om ke'n chin, tohvui in leng om sam ke'n teh; loulingnei leh khaulingneite apou zaw ding; meite leng atung a vuah zusak lou ding in thu ka pe ding," achi hi.
english: I will lay it a wasteland. It won’t be pruned or hoed, but it will grow briers and thorns. I will also command the clouds that they rain no rain on it.”

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA grephuan Israel inkuanpihte ahi a, Judah mite akung deihhuai ahi uhi. Vaihawmna diktat alamen a; himahleh, ngai in, nuaisiahna ahong om zawta ahi; diktatna alamen a, himahleh, ngai in, kikou husa ahong om zawta hi.
english: For the vineyard of Yahweh of Armies is the house of Israel, and the men of Judah his pleasant plant. He looked for justice, but behold, oppression, for righteousness, but behold, a cry of distress.

paite: Gam laizang a amau kia a-omtheihna ding ua mi om samna ding mun himhim om lou khop hial a inn leh inn kizomsak zel leh lou leh lou kizom sakte tung agik hi.
heading: Thil Hoih Lou Hih Mite
english: Woe to those who join house to house, who lay field to field, until there is no room, and you are made to dwell alone in the middle of the land!

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA'N ka bil ah hichibang in achi, “Innte tampi, lian pipite kilawm pipi, ateng ding om lou in ahawm vek ngeingei ding.
english: In my ears, Yahweh of Armies says: “Surely many houses will be desolate, even great and beautiful, unoccupied.

paite: Grephuan tin sawm mun ah bath khat kia suak ding in akisa a, buhchi homer khat tuh in ephah khat kia suak ding in lah akisa ngal a," chi in.
english: For ten acres of vineyard shall yield one bath, and a homer of seed shall yield an ephah.”

paite: Zu delh ding a zingkhang pipi a thou a, uain in akhamgawpsak mateng zan sawt pipi tan a-omsakte atung uh agik hi.
english: Woe to those who rise up early in the morning, that they may follow strong drink, who stay late into the night, until wine inflames them!

paite: Tumging leh kaihgingte, khuangta leh tamngaite, uain toh ankuangluinate uah a-om sek a, himahleh TOUPA nasep angaisang kei ua, akhut thilhihte leng, angaihtuah ngei kei uhi.
english: The harp, lyre, tambourine, and flute, with wine, are at their feasts; but they don’t respect the work of Yahweh, neither have they considered the operation of his hands.

paite: Huaiziak in ka mite zaw, theihna aneih louh ziak un, sal a pi in a-om ua; amizahtakhuaite uh gil akial a, amipite uh dangtak in adang uh akeugawpta hi.
english: Therefore my people go into captivity for lack of knowledge. Their honorable men are famished, and their multitudes are parched with thirst.

paite: Huaiziak in Sheol in agilkialna ana liansak a, akam teh vual louh khop in akata a; huchi in athupinate uh, amipite uh, athupina mahmahte un, alak ua kipaktak a omte toh alutsuk ngoingoi uhi.
english: Therefore Sheol has enlarged its desire, and opened its mouth without measure; and their glory, their multitude, their pomp, and he who rejoices among them, descend into it.

paite: Mineute kunsak in a-om ua, miliante niamsak in a-om ua, kisatheite sukniam in a-omta uhi.
english: So man is brought low, mankind is humbled, and the eyes of the arrogant ones are humbled;

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA bel vaihawmna a tawisang in a-om zawta, Pathian, Mi Siangthou, diktatna a hihsiangthou in a-omta hi.
english: but Yahweh of Armies is exalted in justice, and God the Holy One is sanctified in righteousness.

paite: Huan belamnoute atatna mun ua ata bang un ata diamdiam ding ua, mithau pipite mun sesa a thilte vakvaite'n ane ding uhi.
english: Then the lambs will graze as in their pasture, and strangers will eat the ruins of the rich.

paite: Zuautheihna khaute a thulimlouhna kai a, khauzen a kangtalai kaih bang a khelhna kai sekte tung agik hi!
english: Woe to those who draw iniquity with cords of falsehood, and wickedness as with cart rope,

paite: I muhna ding in hih meng henla, athilhih ding hihkin heh; i theihna ding in Israelte Mi Siangthou lemtheih hong nai in hong tung hen, chi gigete ngei.
english: who say, “Let him make haste, let him hasten his work, that we may see it; let the counsel of the Holy One of Israel draw near and come, that we may know it!”

paite: Thil hoih lou thil hoih chi a, thil hoih lah thil hoih lou chi zel a, vak mial a ngai a, mial vak a ngaisek a, thil khum thil kha a ngai a, thil kha thil khum a ngaisekte atung uh agik hi.
english: Woe to those who call evil good, and good evil; who put darkness for light, and light for darkness; who put bitter for sweet, and sweet for bitter!

paite: Amau pil a kingaihtuahte leh amau mitmuh a teite atung uh agik hi!
english: Woe to those who are wise in their own eyes, and prudent in their own sight!

paite: Uain dawn lam a mihattak, zu hel lam a thagui nei mite atung uh agik!
english: Woe to those who are mighty to drink wine, and champions at mixing strong drink;

paite: Golh nek ziak a migilou siamtangsak sek a, midiktat diktatna laksak sekte ngei.
english: who acquit the guilty for a bribe, but deny justice for the innocent!

paite: Huaiziak in meikuang in buhpawl aliah bei dundun sek bang in leh loupa keu meikuang a apuk zungzung sek bang in azung ua muatna bang in a-om ding a, apak uh leivui bang in atungkah lunglung ding; Sepaihte' TOUPA dan adeih louh ua, Israelte Mi Siangthou thu angaihneu ziak un.
english: Therefore as the tongue of fire devours the stubble, and as the dry grass sinks down in the flame, so their root shall be as rottenness, and their blossom shall go up as dust, because they have rejected the law of Yahweh of Armies, and despised the word of the Holy One of Israel.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA amite tung ah aheh mahmah a, atung uah akhut alik a, avua a, huchi in mualte ah aling vonvon ua, aluangte uh kongzing lak ah nin bulom bang in a-om venvon hi. Huchi tel a ahih in leng ahehna lah adai kei a, akhut alik lailai hi.
english: Therefore Yahweh’s anger burns against his people, and he has stretched out his hand against them and has struck them. The mountains tremble, and their dead bodies are as refuse in the middle of the streets. For all this, his anger is not turned away, but his hand is still stretched out.

paite: Gamlatak a om namte a ding in chiamtehna atakkhe ding a, kawlmong a kipan sam ding in asingsit ding; huchi in ngai in, amaute kintak in ahong pai pah ding uh.
english: He will lift up a banner to the nations from far away, and he will whistle for them from the end of the earth. Behold, they will come speedily and swiftly.

paite: Amau lak ah kuamah agim kei ding ua, akisui sam kei ding uh; kuamah alusu kei ding ua, a-ihmu sam kei ding uh; akawnggak uh lah phelkol in a-om kei ding a, akhedap gakna leng atan sam kei ding hi.
english: No one shall be weary nor stumble among them; no one shall slumber nor sleep, neither shall the belt of their waist be untied, nor the strap of their sandals be broken,

paite: Athalte uh azum mahmah a, athalpeu tengteng uh lai sa in a-om keukou a; asakol chinte uh meisah suang abang a, akangtalai khete uh leng pingpei abang hi.
english: whose arrows are sharp, and all their bows bent. Their horses’ hoofs will be like flint, and their wheels like a whirlwind.

paite: Ahusa ging honhon uh humpinelkai humham bang mai ahi. Humpinelkai lun lai humham bang mai in aging honhon hi; ahi, aging honhon a, asamat ding uh aman ua, bittak in apaimangpih ua, kuamah in ahunkhe thei kei hi.
english: Their roaring will be like a lioness. They will roar like young lions. Yes, they shall roar, and seize their prey and carry it off, and there will be no one to deliver.

paite: Huai ni in tuipi ging hawhaw bang in atung uah aging hawhaw ding uh. Huchi in mi'n gam ahon et uleh, ngai in, mial leh mangbatna ngen ahi a, vak lah huai ameite a hihmial in a-om hi.
english: They will roar against them in that day like the roaring of the sea. If one looks to the land, behold, darkness and distress. The light is darkened in its clouds.
